semantic_objects.name: AttentionItem
semantic_objects.meaning: Derived unresolved user task kept separate from chronology and notification unread state.

semantic_objects.name: ActivityItem
semantic_objects.meaning: Read-only ChopDot milestone projection over accepted domain truth; technical refresh noise is not user activity.

semantic_objects.name: AcceptedEvent
semantic_objects.meaning: Accepted durable domain event/history fact used to rebuild projections; replay is side-effect free.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseAllocation
semantic_objects.meaning: One beneficiary allocation entry inside an Expense Split, bound to the exact Participant it charges and to MoneyV1.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseChangeRecord
semantic_objects.meaning: Read-only history projection showing important accepted changes to an Expense; history does not mutate the Expense.

semantic_objects.name: Expense
semantic_objects.meaning: Recorded shared cost in a Group with exact amount/currency, description, payer, participants/split, date and optional receipt/history.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseIssue
semantic_objects.meaning: Narrowly scoped question/dispute attached to an Expense with reason, optional note and resolution state. Only dependent payment items are blocked.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseMutationGuard
semantic_objects.meaning: Effect-time guard that determines whether expense create/edit/delete is currently allowed while settlement-related locking may apply. The exact lock scope is intentionally unresolved.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseReceipt
semantic_objects.meaning: Optional receipt attachment/reference associated with one Expense; create/edit may add, replace or remove it without changing Expense identity.

semantic_objects.name: ExpenseReview
semantic_objects.meaning: A Participant's review state for an Expense, distinct from editing the Expense itself.

semantic_objects.name: Split
semantic_objects.meaning: Beneficiary allocation of an Expense across selected Participants using Equal, Exact or Shares semantics; it contains participant-bound ExpenseAllocation entries whose MoneyV1 amounts conserve the Expense total.

semantic_objects.name: Group
semantic_objects.meaning: Stable shared workspace identity with display/configuration state, membership and lifecycle. Rename/archive/leave/delete do not silently rewrite ledger truth.

semantic_objects.name: GroupMembership
semantic_objects.meaning: Current access/role relationship between a Participant and Group. Changing access never rewrites historical ledger attribution or other memberships.

semantic_objects.name: Participant
semantic_objects.meaning: Durable group-scoped ledger identity for a person participating in a ChopDot group; may exist without a full account and survives later account linking.

semantic_objects.name: MoneyV1
semantic_objects.meaning: Canonical exact-money partition used for financial conservation: integer minor units plus currency and exponent. Display decimals are not authoritative.

semantic_objects.name: NotificationDelivery
semantic_objects.meaning: Recipient-scoped snapshot/copy with read/unread metadata. Delivery/read state is never underlying domain authority.

semantic_objects.name: PaymentIntent
semantic_objects.meaning: Typed settlement lifecycle for an already-existing obligation. Preparing/authorizing a payment is distinct from execution, receipt and closure.

semantic_objects.name: SettlementScope
semantic_objects.meaning: Canonical exact settlement scope: payer, recipient, amount, one currency, source groups/items, selected method, expiry and idempotency identity.

semantic_objects.name: Position
semantic_objects.meaning: Derived financial position showing what is owed/owing with currency separation and source lineage. It is read-only product truth derived from underlying records.

operation_contracts.name: Create Expense
rules: Common path is amount + description with editable defaults.
Custom split must conserve the expense total.

operation_contracts.name: Edit Expense
rules: Reuse Journey 05 controls with existing values.

operation_contracts.name: Agree with Expense
rules: Looks right resolves the reviewer's review state, not unrelated domain state.

operation_contracts.name: Raise Expense Issue
rules: Issue includes reason and optional note.
Only dependent payment items are blocked.

operation_contracts.name: Resolve / reassess Expense Issue
rules: Journey 07 owns issue resolution status. Owner correction remains Journey 06; a correction does not fabricate reviewer agreement.

operation_contracts.name: Withdraw Expense Issue
rules: Reviewer may withdraw their raised issue through Journey 07.
Withdrawal changes issue status; it does not edit the Expense or fabricate payment/settlement state.

operation_contracts.name: Reply to Expense Issue
rules: Owner may reply through Journey 07 without editing the Expense.
A reply does not equal reviewer agreement or issue resolution; the reviewer can reassess with Looks right or Still off.

laws.name: Expense split conserves amount
laws.rule: An explicit custom split must add to the Expense total within the exact money partition.

laws.name: Review and edit ownership stay separate
laws.rule: Journey 06 owns expense mutation; Journey 07 owns agreement/question/issue semantics. Owner correction does not fabricate reviewer agreement.

laws.name: Expense allocation preserves participant attribution
laws.rule: Every allocation entry is bound to a selected participant_id in the Expense's Group and carries MoneyV1 in the Expense partition. Correct total conservation never substitutes for correct per-participant attribution.

laws.name: Expense mutation obeys current settlement-related guard
laws.rule: Expense create/edit/delete must evaluate the current mutation guard before effect; a locked result prevents the mutation and preserves user-entered context. The exact settlement dependency scope of the guard is unresolved and must not be invented.

laws.name: Accepted Expense mutations feed read-only change history
laws.rule: Important accepted Expense changes are represented through replay-safe accepted history; Expense history is read-only and replay does not repeat the mutation.

laws.name: Issues block only dependencies
laws.rule: An unresolved expense issue blocks only dependent payment items, not unrelated actionable balances.

laws.name: Position is derived and currency-separated
laws.rule: Position is a read model; mixed currencies remain separate and source group/item lineage stays explainable.

laws.name: Activity and notification are projections
laws.rule: Activity is read-only; unread is not unresolved; notification delivery/read cannot mutate the underlying domain result.

laws.name: Replay is side-effect free
laws.rule: Accepted history is append-only/replay-safe; replay rebuilds projections and never repeats external/payment/signing/receipt/closure effects.

laws.name: Access/lifecycle does not rewrite ledger truth
laws.rule: Removal, leave, transfer, rename, archive and delete prerequisites cannot silently rewrite expense attribution, balances, historical ledger facts or other memberships.

laws.name: Exact partitioned money
laws.rule: Canonical financial conservation uses integer minor units with currency and exponent; cross-partition values never combine silently and display decimals are non-authoritative.

laws.name: Navigation is not evidence
laws.rule: Back, reload, route changes or time alone never convert unknown/pending state into success, failure, cancellation or receipt.

laws.name: Stale truth refreshes before write
laws.rule: Stale/conflicting reviewed state refreshes current owner truth and requires re-review rather than overwriting it.

composition_laws.rule: The same underlying object identity survives adjacent journey handoffs; routes do not create replacement domain objects.
Only an operation owner may mutate its semantic object; projections/read models cannot mutate source truth.
Derived views refresh from accepted underlying state; no journey manually overwrites Position, Activity, Insights or history to simulate an outcome.
Possible-effect recovery preserves the original operation identity and returns to the owning journey after verified outcome/safe retry/explicit stop.
Gate A partial capability coverage is not promoted to full journey integration.
Approved Goldens define experience projection; the schema references them and does not duplicate or redesign their visual hierarchy/copy.

continuity_contracts.rule: J05 creates the same Expense lineage consumed by J08/J06/J07.
J06 mutates the existing Expense and appends accepted history; it never creates a correction-copy Expense.
J07 review/issue/reply/withdraw state remains attached to the same Expense and reviewer/issue lineage.
Group Home refreshes Attention/Recent/Position from accepted underlying state; standalone J10/J18 screens are not part of Gate B.

build_constraints.rule: Do not infer full J05/J08 coverage from the bounded Gate A expense demonstration.
Do not redesign Golden hierarchy, copy, actions, permission boundaries, or recovery meaning.
Do not introduce production storage, real authentication, financial execution, provider selection, Product Integrator, protected merge, or deployment as Gate B work.
Do not use Product IR/funding/conformance research branches as product authority.

contexts.name: Expense mutation guard
contexts.note: This context is an effect-time precondition, not a navigation payload. Its exact settlement dependency scope is a recorded product decision gap.

gate_a_reuse.rule: Gate A acceptance never implies full J05, J08, J10, or J18 integration.

authority_blockers.statement: J05's frozen structured-source README declares six slices, but five are absent from the frozen authority tree.
authority_blockers.resolution_rule: Do not reconstruct or re-scope the approved J05 Golden inside the schema. Recover the approved slices from authoritative evidence/history or make an explicit product-authority decision.

product_decisions_required.statement: Historical J08/J05/J06 behavior includes settlement-related expense mutation locking, while later settlement contracts narrow dependency blocking to affected items. The final mutation-lock scope is not settled by the frozen sources.
product_decisions_required.handling: Represent the guard and enforce fail-closed locked behavior, but do not choose group-wide vs item-scoped lock semantics before an explicit product decision.
